newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK POLICE ARREST FOUR AFTER DETONATOR FIND.
newsitem.headline: GREEK POLICE ARREST FOUR AFTER DETONATOR FIND.

text.p: Greek police arrested four men after port authorities discovered seven detonators in the cabin of a passenger ship docked in the port of Chania on the southern isle of Crete, the merchant shipping ministry said in a statement.
Police are still searching for four women who boarded the ship with the men, using the same group ticket.
The men were arrested in the city of Heraclion. Five more detonators were found in their luggage. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
